citation: Murphy AP et al. Natural history of limb girdle muscular dystrophy R9 over 6 years: searching for trial endpoints. Ann Clin Transl Neurol 2019;6(6):1033-1045. doi:10.1002/acn3.774

research_question.text: Which functional assessments and MRI fat-fraction measures change detectably over 6 years in an LGMD R9 cohort, to inform outcome measures for future trials.
research_question.source_sentence: The purpose of this study was to investigate various outcome measures in the previously recruited LGMD R9 cohort over 6 years.

setting.population: Participants with LGMD R9 (homozygous FKRP c.826C>A) from an earlier 1-year natural-history study, re-assessed about 6 years after their original visit.
setting.period: Baseline visits 2009-2011; follow-up as close to 6 years later as possible.
setting.site: Four centres: Newcastle upon Tyne (UK), London (UK), Copenhagen (Denmark), Paris (France).
setting.source_sentence: All available participants from the original study, running from 2009 to 2011,… were approached to undergo further functional assessments and quantitative MRI measurements as close to 6 years after the original measurements as possible.

data_sources.name: Dryad dataset doi:10.5061/dryad.f3r6799
data_sources.summary: Anonymised per-participant MRI measurements, physical function tests and clinical characteristics at baseline and 6-year follow-up.
data_sources.source_sentence: The anonymized MRI measurements, physical function tests and clinical characteristics will be made available via the Dryad data repository

general_manipulations.description: Timed functional tests performed: 6-minute walk test, 10-m walk or run, timed up and go, stair ascend, stair descend, chair rise.
general_manipulations.source_sentence: Participants underwent a series of functional assessments, including: 6-min walk test (6MWT),…10-m walk or run,…timed up and go,…stair ascend, stair descend and chair rise.

general_manipulations.description: Myometry (hand-held, dominant side) for knee flexion, knee extension, hip abduction, hip adduction and ankle dorsiflexion, in kg.
general_manipulations.source_sentence: Myometry was performed on the dominant side using a hand-held myometer (Citec or Microfet) assessing: knee flexion, knee extension, hip abduction, hip adduction, and ankle dorsiflexion.
general_manipulations.gap_note: Hip flexion is reported in Table 1 but is not among the myometry movements listed in the Methods.

general_manipulations.description: Forced vital capacity expressed as % of predicted value for height.
general_manipulations.source_sentence: Forced vital capacity (FVC) was measured and expressed as a percentage of predicted value for height.
general_manipulations.gap_note: Methods do not mention that FVC was measured both sitting and lying; Table 1 reports both positions.

general_manipulations.description: Timed tests are expressed as velocities so that participants unable to perform can be included: 10-m walk/run = metres / time; stairs = 4 stairs / time; timed up and go = 6 m / time.
general_manipulations.source_sentence: To incorporate participants unable to perform assessments, results were expressed as a velocity (msec-1 or stairs/sec). For the 10-m walk or run, the number of meters was divided by the time taken, the number of stairs (four) was divided by stair ascend and descend times, and the 6 m were divided by timed up and go test time.
general_manipulations.gap_note: The velocity assigned to a participant who cannot perform a test is not stated (zero is implied but not written).

general_manipulations.description: Chair rise is analysed as a time in seconds; participants unable to perform it are given 10,000 s so they rank last in the Wilcoxon test.
general_manipulations.source_sentence: For nonparametric testing of the chair rise time, where a participant was unable to perform a timed functional assessment, a value greater than the longest possible result (10,000s) was used to provide correct ranking.
general_manipulations.gap_note: Says the 10,000 s value is used 'for nonparametric testing'. It does not say whether the same value is used when computing the chair-rise medians.

general_manipulations.description: Missing data / analysis set: each Table 1 row reports how many participants had paired (baseline and follow-up) values for some rows.
general_manipulations.gap_note: No missing-data rule is stated. Footnotes give paired counts for some rows (FVC sitting and chair rise: 17; FVC lying: 16; timed up and go, 10-m walk/run, stair ascent and descent: 22), but it is not said whether the medians use only participants with paired values or every available value at each visit. Rows without a footnote are presumably complete.

tables.caption: Table 1. The median change in functional assessments over the follow-up of 6 years.

table_specific_filters.description: Row footnotes on paired data: FVC sitting and chair rise -> 17 participants with paired values; FVC lying -> 16; timed up and go, 10-m walk/run, stair ascent, stair descent -> 22.
Chair rise: participants unable to perform were given 10,000 s for the Wilcoxon test.
table_specific_filters.source_sentence: Participants unable to perform the chair rise were given a value of 10,000 (effectively infinity) for the purposes of the Wilcoxon nonparametric rank signed test.

specification.description: Descriptive statistics: median (and range) at baseline and at 6 years.
specification.source_sentence: Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS v24, with data presented as median and range unless otherwise indicated.

specification.description: P value: Wilcoxon signed-rank test comparing baseline and 6-year values.
specification.source_sentence: Statistical significance was calculated using the Wilcoxon test for nonparametric data.
specification.gap_note: The Wilcoxon variant is not stated: exact or normal approximation, continuity correction, and handling of zero differences and ties. SPSS defaults to the asymptotic test.

specification.description: Significance threshold; significant P values carry the marker 'a'.
specification.source_sentence: Statistical significance was taken to be P < 0.05.

specification.description: SRM = mean of paired differences over 6 years divided by the standard deviation of those differences.
specification.source_sentence: Standardized response means (SRM) were calculated for all outcome measures by taking the average of the paired difference over the 6 years divided by the standard deviation of these differences.
specification.gap_note: The direction of the difference (follow-up minus baseline, or the reverse) and the SD denominator (n-1 or n) are not stated.
